1.why: Body text uses a clean sans-serif typeface with adequate line height, though the developer Logs panel is set in small monospace type.

2.why: All visible text is short sentence-case prose with no italics, all-caps styling, or dense paragraphs.

3.why: The single-column card layout is readable at mobile width, but the dark Logs panel overflows the card edges, showing imperfect small-screen layout.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Confirm your account details before setting up payment security.' are brief and written in plain language.

5.why: Placeholder values (marcus@example.com, +15551234567) show the expected format for both visible inputs, though no example is ever shown for code entry.

6.why: Every screen contains only one- or two-line text blocks, so the user is never required to read a long block of text to proceed.

7.why: The flow never displays OTP or recovery codes and provides no copy affordance anywhere, so long codes cannot be copied.

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry appears on any screen, as the authenticator setup step never renders.

9.why: Standard labeled email and phone fields would typically accept browser autofill, but no password-manager or autocomplete support is demonstrated for secrets.

10.why: The 'Sign in to continue' heading and full-width blue Continue button stand out clearly, though no progress indicator shows the current step of the enrolment.

11.why: Each screen presents a single primary action (Continue) with no competing actions.

12.why: After pressing Continue the only feedback is a generic 'We could not complete that request. Please try again.' banner, and the flow never plainly states what happened or what comes next.

13.why: The form stays filled and Continue remains enabled so retry is possible without penalty, but no reveal, hide, or re-request controls for codes exist anywhere.

14.why: The error message avoids blaming the user ('We could not…') but never states the actual problem or how to fix it.

15.why: No countdown or time limit is visible on any displayed screen, but code entry never renders so generous time to enter codes cannot be confirmed.
